tours.title: Assam: Wild Brahmaputra & Tea Highlands
tours.overview: Explore Kaziranga National Park, home to the Great One-Horned Rhinoceros, ancient tea estates in Jorhat, and serene river sunsets along the Brahmaputra.
tours.tagline: Wildlife sanctuaries, lush tea estates & royal Brahmaputra river trails.
tours.weatherInfo: Pleasant winter days (12°C - 24°C) with crisp highland breeze.

tours.title: Meghalaya: Abode of the Clouds & Living Roots
tours.overview: Discover the mystical Double Decker Living Root Bridges, crystalline waters of Umngot River in Dawki, and awe-inspiring Nohkalikai waterfalls in Cherrapunji.
tours.tagline: Misty cloud kingdoms, crystalline Dawki river & ancient root bridges.
tours.weatherInfo: Misty and invigorating (10°C - 22°C) with scenic rainforest terrain.

tours.title: Kenya: Great Migration & African Safari Odyssey
tours.overview: Witness the iconic Big Five across the legendary Maasai Mara savannah, hot air balloon flights at sunrise, and luxury tented safari camps under starlit skies.
tours.tagline: Untamed African savannahs, Big Five safaris & luxury savannah camps.
highlights: Maasai Mara Big Five Game Drives
tours.weatherInfo: Sunny and warm savannah days (20°C - 28°C) with cool bush evenings.
tours.bestTimeToVisit: July to October (Great Migration) & January to February

tours.title: Japan: Imperial Heritage, Tokyo Lights & Mount Fuji
tours.overview: Immerse yourself in neon-lit Tokyo, serene Kyoto zen temples, traditional Onsen ryokan stays, and breathtaking panoramic views of Mount Fuji.
tours.tagline: Ancient Kyoto shrines, futuristic Tokyo & majestic Mount Fuji vistas.
tours.bestTimeToVisit: March to May (Cherry Blossom) & October to November (Autumn Foliage)

tours.title: Philippines: Palawan Turquoise Lagoons & El Nido Islands
tours.overview: Island-hop through emerald karst lagoons, pristine white coral sandbars, and secret beach sanctuaries in El Nido, Coron, and Boracay.
tours.tagline: Emerald karst lagoons, hidden white beaches & tropical island escapes.
tours.weatherInfo: Tropical sunshine (26°C - 32°C) with refreshing sea breezes.

tours.title: Azerbaijan: Land of Fire & Caspian Grandeur
tours.overview: Experience Baku’s futuristic Flame Towers alongside UNESCO Old City streets, mud volcanoes of Gobustan, and the alpine grandeur of Shahdag mountain resort.
tours.tagline: Futuristic Baku architecture, ancient Silk Road towers & Caucasus peaks.
highlights: Baku Flame Towers & Old City Trail
tours.bestTimeToVisit: April to June & September to November

tours.title: Uzbekistan: Jewel of the Great Silk Road
tours.overview: Journey back in time through the sapphire and turquoise tiled madrasahs of Samarkand Registan, the historic minarets of Bukhara, and Khiva oasis.
tours.tagline: Sapphire dome madrasahs, ancient Silk Road trade routes & Registan marvels.
tours.weatherInfo: Crisp, sunny days (16°C - 25°C) with clear blue skies.
tours.bestTimeToVisit: March to May & September to November

tours.title: Europe: Grand Alpine Splendor & Classic Capitals
tours.overview: An extraordinary grand voyage across Swiss snow-capped peaks, Paris boulevard romance, Venice gondola canals, and Roman architectural wonders.
tours.tagline: Swiss alpine peaks, Parisian glamour & romantic Venetian waterways.

events.title: Kashmir Autumn Gold & Saffron Harvest Expedition
events.description: Join an intimate 12-traveler expedition witnessing the legendary golden chinar tree foliage and the annual saffron bloom in Pampore valley.
highlights: Dal Lake golden hour private houseboat

events.title: Andaman Deep Blue Coral Safari & Bioluminescent Night Kayaking
events.description: Exclusive scuba and marine expedition on Swaraj Dweep with night mangrove bioluminescence tours and private beach cabana living.

events.title: Vietnam Summer Monsoon Cultural Trail (Past Expedition)
events.description: A completed summer expedition across central Vietnam ancient citadels.

promotions.tagline: Experience the Island of the Gods in Pure Opulence
promotions.description: Immerse yourself in secluded jungle pool villas in Ubud, private yacht cruises across Nusa Penida, sacred water blessings, and Michelin-tier cliffside dining in Uluwatu.
highlights: Private Floating Breakfast in Ayung River Valley Villa
VIP Luxury Yacht Charter to Nusa Penida & Crystal Bay
Helicopter Aerial Tour of Mount Batur Volcano
Exclusive Sunset Access at Uluwatu Cliff Temple

promotions.tagline: Emerald Karsts, Imperial Citadels & Golden Lanterns
promotions.description: Cruise emerald waters aboard a 5-star presidential junk boat, explore the glowing lantern streets of ancient Hoi An, and savor curated French-Indochine culinary masterclasses.
highlights: 2-Night Luxury Cruise on Lan Ha & Ha Long Bay
Private Street Food Tasting in Hanoi Old Quarter
Hoi An UNESCO Heritage Walking Tour & Lantern Making
Ba Na Hills Golden Bridge Early Morning VIP Access

services.title: School Group Tours
services.shortDesc: Safe, organized, and educational group tours for schools and colleges fostering learning and team spirit.

services.title: Corporate Group Travel
services.shortDesc: Comprehensive corporate offsites, executive retreats, team building tours, and MICE travel management.

testimonials.name: Dr. Rajiv Malhotra & Family
testimonials.review: The cedarwood houseboat on Nigeen Lake was peaceful and majestic. Having dedicated travel coordination and local guidance made traveling with elderly parents effortless. The Kashmiri Wazwan dinner was unforgettable.

testimonials.name: Elena Rostova
testimonials.review: Ha Long Bay aboard the private balcony suite cruise exceeded all expectations. Floating through misty karst islands while sipping champagne felt like a movie scene. Everything was punctual and ultra-luxurious.

testimonials.name: Marcus & Sophia Vance
testimonials.review: Night kayaking through glowing bioluminescent mangroves in Havelock was pure magic. The Taj Exotica villa was heavenly, and the concierge arranged every single detail flawlessly via WhatsApp.
